neighbours.label: 'top' as a concrete noun or head of a compound: an upper surface, lid or garment (set-top, table top, blacktop, soft top); 'on top of', 'top of the hill' and attributive 'top prize' stay under it
fire: The old table top was scratched and stained by years of use.
Install the set-top decoder behind the television in the lounge.
The camper van has a pop-top roof that lifts at the campsite.
Workers resurfaced the parking lot with fresh blacktop this week.
Her dress was a cotton top with a long linen skirt.
A hard top for the jeep costs more than a soft one.
Birds nested high in the tree-top behind our shed.
She wiped down the stove top after making the soup.
quiet: The old table was scratched and stained by years of use.
Install the decoder at the top of the cabinet in the lounge.
The camper van has a low roof that lifts at the campsite.
Workers resurfaced the parking lot with fresh gravel this week.
Her dress was a top choice with the judges at the show.
A top speed for the jeep is more than a hundred miles an hour.
